aim_summary.goal: Add slot patterns across the semantic top and bottom surfaces of the plastic part while preserving all non-targeted geometry.
preserve_targets: all plastic-part geometry outside the top and bottom slot-pattern regions
aim_summary.expected_outcome: Repeated slot geometry exists across both the top and bottom surfaces, with no specified function or behavior and with unrelated geometry unchanged.

operations_plan.summary: Create a repeated rounded-end slot cut pattern on the semantic top (+Y) surface of the plastic frame body.

steps.description: Cut slots at resolved pattern locations on the top surface; slot dimensions, layout, target face, orientation, and extent require clarification.

expected_result.geometry: A repeated pattern of slot geometry is distributed across the semantic top surface of the plastic frame body.

validation_criteria.description: Verify that a repeated slot pattern exists across the semantic top surface.
Verify that geometry outside the top slot-pattern region remains unchanged.

operations_plan.summary: Create a repeated rounded-end slot cut pattern on the semantic bottom (-Y) surface of the plastic frame body.

steps.description: Cut slots at resolved pattern locations on the bottom surface of the body produced by the top-pattern operation; slot dimensions, layout, target face, orientation, and extent require clarification.

expected_result.geometry: A repeated pattern of slot geometry is distributed across the semantic bottom surface, with slot patterns present on both top and bottom surfaces.

validation_criteria.description: Verify that a repeated slot pattern exists across the semantic bottom surface.
Verify that slot patterns are present on both the semantic top and bottom sides.
Verify that all geometry outside the top and bottom slot-pattern regions remains unchanged.
